name: Conversational AI & Virtual Agents
description: Natural-language voicebots and digital virtual agents combining deterministic intent NLU, structured slot filling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), hallucination guardrails, and warm context handoff.
roleInCenter: Autonomous conversational resolver: understands free-form customer utterances, executes grounded self-service workflows, and hands off complex contacts with structured context.

glossary.definition: Natural Language Understanding classifier that maps free-form customer utterances to canonical contact intents with confidence scores
Dialog extraction mechanism that captures required parameters such as order dates, account identifiers, or amounts across multi-turn prompts
Generative response architecture that restricts LLM synthesis strictly to retrieved knowledge base passages and verified CRM facts
Pre- and post-generation safety layer verifying factual entailment, policy compliance, and prompt-injection resistance before utterance delivery
Structured escalation protocol transferring verified identity, intent, extracted slots, and conversation summary to a live queue when self-service cannot complete
End-to-end delay between end-of-speech detection and the first synthesized audio byte or chat token returned by the virtual agent
Conversation memory maintaining active intent, filled slots, API transaction outcomes, and fallback retry counters across turns
Targeted follow-up question triggered when top intent confidence falls into the medium verification band between two competing intents
Acoustic turn-taking detector that distinguishes natural mid-sentence pauses from completed customer utterances in voicebots

children.name: Prompt Injection & Jailbreak Detection

metrics.name: True Conversational Containment Rate
metrics.definition: Share of virtual agent sessions that fully resolve the customer intent without live agent transfer or repeat contact within 24 hours

metrics.name: Virtual Agent First Contact Resolution
metrics.definition: Percentage of bot-handled inquiries requiring no follow-up contact across any channel on the same issue

metrics.name: P95 Conversational Turn Latency
metrics.definition: 95th percentile response delay from customer end-of-turn to virtual agent response start

metrics.name: Escalated Contact Handle Time
metrics.definition: Average live-agent handle time on contacts escalated from the virtual agent with pre-filled slots and summary

metrics.name: Virtual Agent Post-Session CSAT
metrics.definition: Customer satisfaction rating captured immediately after a self-service virtual agent conversation

failureModes.name: Ungrounded Policy or Refund Hallucination
failureModes.signal: Escalated callers cite non-existent refund promises or policy rules generated by the bot; QA flags bot transcript discrepancies
failureModes.mitigation: Enforce strict RAG entailment scoring, zero-temperature decoding, and deterministic template responses for financial policies

failureModes.name: Containment Trap & Deflection Loop
failureModes.signal: High apparent containment paired with plummeting CSAT, hang-ups on turn 4+, and immediate callback spikes
failureModes.mitigation: Trigger automatic warm escalation after two disambiguation failures or rising frustration sentiment

failureModes.name: Premature Endpointing & Turn Collision
failureModes.signal: Voicebot interrupts callers mid-account-number or pauses over 2.5 seconds causing 'hello?' utterances
failureModes.mitigation: Tune slot-specific VAD silence thresholds and stream filler acknowledgments during slow backend tool calls

failureModes.name: Context Loss on Escalation Handoff
failureModes.signal: Live agents ask customers to repeat authentication and issue details already captured by the virtual agent
failureModes.mitigation: Bind dialog state slots and structured summary payload directly to ACD SIP headers and desktop co-pilot screen pop

scoringModel.name: Conversational AI Grounding & Turn Performance Scorecard
scoringModel.note: Evaluates virtual agent and voicebot interactions on RAG factual entailment, intent and slot precision, sub-second turn-taking latency, and warm context preservation on human handoff.

dimensions.name: RAG Grounding & Policy Faithfulness
dimensions.description: Strict factual entailment to retrieved knowledge base passages and verified CRM records with zero fabricated policies or unauthorized commitments
sampleCriteria: Every substantive claim entails directly from cited KM chunk or CRM tool output
Commercial and refund guardrails block unapproved financial promises
Adversarial prompt-injection or out-of-scope probes safely deflected

dimensions.name: Intent Recognition & Slot Disambiguation
dimensions.description: Accurate multi-intent classification, constrained entity extraction, and targeted clarification when posterior entropy falls in the medium confidence band
sampleCriteria: Correct primary intent resolved or disambiguated within one follow-up turn
Typed slots (dates, amounts, account IDs) extracted and normalized accurately
Zero repetitive reprompts for information already stated by the caller

dimensions.name: Turn-to-First-Audio Latency & Duplex Fluency
dimensions.description: Natural acoustic endpointing, sub-second streaming response initiation, and immediate full-duplex TTS cancellation on caller barge-in
sampleCriteria: Turn-to-first-audio latency maintained below 800ms at P95
VAD endpointing avoids premature cutoff during digit or account recitation
Immediate TTS stop within 150ms when caller barges in

dimensions.name: Warm Escalation & Context Handoff Continuity
dimensions.description: Timely escalation on frustration or repeated no-match turns with full slot state and conversation summary hydrated onto the agent desktop
sampleCriteria: Escalation triggered immediately upon consecutive no-match or sentiment bailout
Verified identity, intent, and extracted slots passed in ACD handoff envelope
Receiving agent greets customer with full context without asking to repeat

exchanges: Approved knowledge chunks and embeddings retrieved for RAG grounding
Unanswered query gaps and low-confidence citations logged for content authoring
Classified intent, extracted entity slots, and urgency passed on warm queue transfer
Real-time queue expected wait time checked before offering live transfer vs callback
Structured bot transcript summary and verified slots rendered in agent co-pilot panel
Suggested next-best-response pre-populated from prior bot tool lookups
Customer profile, recent orders, and tier fetched for personalized dialog turns
Self-service transaction outcomes and interaction records written to customer timeline

stateVariables.description: Continuous conditional Shannon entropy of the NLU intent distribution given streaming utterance prefix u_t, governing direct execution versus disambiguation or fallback
Continuous cosine similarity and natural-language inference entailment margin between generated response tokens and retrieved canonical KM passages
Control barrier potential that diverges as grounding margin gamma_rag(t) approaches the minimum faithfulness threshold gamma_min, blocking ungrounded token emission
End-to-end streaming turn-to-first-audio latency state integrating VAD endpointing window, RAG retrieval delay, LLM time-to-first-token, and neural TTS synthesis
Cumulative warm-handoff trigger potential driven by unresolved intent entropy, slot retry count, and caller acoustic-textual frustration gradient

differentialEquations.name: Streaming Utterance Intent Entropy Evolution SDE
differentialEquations.formula: dH(I | u_t) = -kappa_asr * I_info(du_t; I) * dt + eta_noise * WER_inst(t) * dt + sigma_ent * dW_t
differentialEquations.interpretation: Describes how conditional intent entropy H(I | u_t) contracts at rate proportional to mutual information gain I_info(du_t; I) as streaming ASR tokens arrive, counteracted by acoustic word-error noise WER_inst(t)

differentialEquations.name: RAG Semantic Grounding & Hallucination Control Barrier Equation
differentialEquations.formula: B_halluc(t) = (gamma_rag(t) - gamma_min)^(-1),   dB_halluc(t) * inv(dt) <= alpha_cbf * (B_max - B_halluc(t))
differentialEquations.interpretation: Enforces positive invariance of the safe grounded generation set {gamma_rag(t) > gamma_min}: if candidate token decoding drives gamma_rag(t) toward gamma_min, the barrier potential B_halluc(t) clamps generation to deterministic KM templates or triggers warm escalation

differentialEquations.name: Streaming Turn-to-First-Audio (TTFA) Latency Dynamics
differentialEquations.formula: d_tau_ttfa(t) * inv(dt) = -mu_pipe * (tau_ttfa(t) - tau_vad(t) - tau_rag_cache(t)) + beta_kv * L_context(t) * B_gpu(t)^(-1)
differentialEquations.interpretation: Couples VAD endpointing delay tau_vad(t), semantic cache hit time tau_rag_cache(t), and KV-cache context length L_context(t) scaled by GPU token bandwidth B_gpu(t) to keep turn-to-first-audio below the human conversational rhythm threshold

scaleInvariants: Zero-ungrounded-commit barrier invariant: control barrier B_halluc(t) guarantees P(gamma_rag(t) < gamma_min) = 0 for all financial, policy, and account-mutating utterances
Sub-800ms P95 conversational rhythm invariant: streaming ASR-to-RAG-to-TTS pipelining bounds tau_ttfa(t) below 0.8 seconds independent of total knowledge corpus size via HNSW vector indexing
Lossless handoff state conservation: 100% of verified entity slots and dialog state tracker variables transfer bijectively into the ACD and Desktop Assist context envelope upon escalation
